title: French port strikes: Unions 'will get better working conditions', but can they curb militarisation?
summary: Carys Garland is pleased to welcome Renaud Foucart, Senior Lecturer at the Department of Economics ECARES at Lancaster University. An international dockworkers’ strike brings into focus the relationship between organized labor, technological change and Europe’s expanding military investment. Foucart argues that port workers’ strategic position in global supply chains gives them exceptional leverage: “They know how powerful they are.” While questioning their ability to redirect military policy, he expects that leverage to secure concessions on automation and working conditions: “They can get those concessions. And I think they will get them.”

title: «Капитан Пикар воплощал лучшее, что в нас есть — как и человек, который его играл». Умер Патрик Стюарт, звезда «Стартрека», «Людей Икс» и британского театра. Вот как его вспоминают коллеги и журналисты
summary: Умер сэр Патрик Стюарт, британский актер театра и кино. В мире его знают прежде всего за роли капитана Пикара в сериале «Стартрек: Следующее поколение», который выходил с 1987 по 1994 год, и телепата Чарльза Ксавье (он же профессор Икс) в фильмах о Людях Икс. При этом в Лондоне, Нью-Йорке и родном городе Шекспира Стратфорде-на-Эйвоне Стюарт известен еще и как большой театральный актер, сыгравший десятки классических ролей — в том числе Отелло, Макбета и Марка Антония. Вот что пишут об актере СМИ и коллеги.

title: Sofia Sapega, ex-girlfriend of former Belarusian opposition journalist Roman Protasevich, recounts her time in prison and his testimony against her after the 2021 Ryanair diversion
summary: The Belarusian news outlet Zerkalo has published the second part of an extensive interview with Sofia Sapega, the former girlfriend of Roman Protasevich, a former editor-in-chief of the opposition Telegram channel Nexta. In May 2021, Belarusian authorities used false pretenses to force a plane flying from Athens to Vilnius to land in Minsk so they could arrest Protasevich. Sapega was detained along with him. Since then, she has lived under house arrest with Protasevich and broken up with him, been sentenced to six years in prison, spent a year in a penal colony, received a pardon, and returned to her old life in Lithuania.
